result_text:
`read_message` now reports a line that isn't valid UTF-8 as `ChannelError::Malformed`, and `cargo check -p shep-channel` passes. I didn't run any tests, since you asked for source only.

The change is in `crates/shep-channel/src/session.rs`. It now reads the line as raw bytes up to the newline and checks for UTF-8 afterwards. That reads the whole bad line, so the next call returns the frame on the following line. End of input still returns `Ok(None)`, and a real read failure still returns `Io`.
